answers.解决什么: 对一家中国 A 股上市公司，用我上传的财报，把问题点到的科目和一组固定的核心指标算出来、看清走势；再对营业收入、归母净利润（问题点名的再加别的流量科目）做预测，每个预测都有回测、区间和假设。
answers.不解决什么: 不逐科目预测整套报表；比率不单独外推；数据里没有的不硬算、不冒充；只做 A 股上市公司。
answers.输入是什么: 我上传的财报数据（格式待定，见缺口 G1）。

workflow.title: 定范围
workflow.summary: 认出公司、期间、要看的科目和指标，确认它在你的数据里
workflow.why: 先确定看的是哪家公司、哪几期、哪些数；公司不在你上传的数据里就停下说明，不去别处找。
workflow.method_text: Fix the scope before any number is used. Read data only with list_my_data and read_my_data, passing the task id given in the step instructions; there is no other data source. 1) Call list_my_data. 2) Identify the company the question is about (A-share security code and name). If it is not covered by any listed dataset, set `stop_reason` to say the user's data has no such company, leave `items` empty and stop; never look elsewhere. 3) Set `period` to the range the question asks for; if vague, use the latest five years available and say so in `assumptions`. 4) `items` = the line items the question names plus the fixed core metrics: operating revenue, net profit attributable to owners of the parent, net profit after non-recurring items, operating cash flow, gross margin, net margin, return on equity, operating cash flow to net profit, revenue and profit growth. 5) If a forecast is asked, list the quarters to forecast in `forecast.horizon` (at most 4). 6) List in `datasets` which of the user's datasets hold this company. Reply with ONE JSON object only, no markdown fences, no commentary before or after it. Do not modify any files unless this step says so.

workflow.title: 数据摸底
workflow.summary: 看清你的数据有哪些表、哪些报告期、单位与合并口径
workflow.why: 先知道手里的数是什么样，后面的换算和对照才不会错。
workflow.method_text: Profile the user's data for this company. Read CSV and Excel datasets with read_my_table (every sheet: its column labels and row labels) and PDFs with read_my_data; there is no other data source; pass the task id given in the step instructions on every call. List: the statements present (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement, annual report text), for each table its dataset_id, sheet and the column labels that are report periods, the report periods (Q1, H1, Q3, annual per year), whether values are cumulative per report period, the unit, and whether figures are consolidated or parent-only. If both consolidated and parent-only figures are present and the scope does not settle which to use, ask the user. Reply with ONE JSON object only, no markdown fences, no commentary before or after it. Do not modify any files unless this step says so.

workflow.title: 勾稽
workflow.summary: 三张表之间、前后两期之间对不对得上
workflow.why: 数据本身对不上，后面的指标和预测都不可信；对不上的照实列出。
workflow.method_text: Check the statements against each other for every period in scope. Read CSV and Excel data with read_my_table to see sheet names, row labels and column labels; a cell address is <dataset_id>:<sheet>!<row label>@<column label>, exactly as read_my_table shows them. A number taken from the data as is carries its cell address in `address`. Every derived number is computed with compute, never in your head, and carries the returned id in `compute_id`; never type a number yourself. If compute refuses because a denominator is zero, the figure is not applicable. Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every tool call. Checks: total assets = total liabilities + total equity; net profit attributable to owners of the parent + minority interests = net profit; ending cash = beginning cash + net increase in cash (cash flow statement); this period's opening balance = last period's closing balance for the main balance sheet items. For each check compute the left side and the right side with compute (a side that is one cell is computed with the expression `x`), then the difference with expression `left - right` on the two ids. A difference above 1 yuan in absolute value is a failure. List every check per period with both sides, both ids and the difference; put the ids of every check that holds into `balanced`. Do not stop on failures: they go to limitations and those periods are kept out of the forecast window. Reply with ONE JSON object only, no markdown fences, no commentary before or after it. Do not modify any files unless this step says so.

workflow.title: 取数
workflow.summary: 把要用到的科目按期取出来，季报累计数换成单季，每个数带出处
workflow.why: 每个数从哪来、怎么换算，先摆出来给你核对。
workflow.method_text: Extract every item in scope.items that is a line item, for every report period in scope.period. Read CSV and Excel data with read_my_table to see sheet names, row labels and column labels; a cell address is <dataset_id>:<sheet>!<row label>@<column label>, exactly as read_my_table shows them. A number taken from the data as is carries its cell address in `address`. Every derived number is computed with compute, never in your head, and carries the returned id in `compute_id`; never type a number yourself. If compute refuses because a denominator is zero, the figure is not applicable. Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every tool call. Put every value as reported (cumulative for income and cash flow items, point-in-time for balance sheet items) into `raw` with its address. For income and cash flow items add the single-quarter value: Q1 is the Q1 report value itself (no computation); Q2, Q3 and Q4 are computed with expression `cur - prev`, where cur is the cell of this report (half-year, Q3 report, annual) and prev the cell of the report before it (Q1, half-year, Q3 report); put those into `single_quarter` with their ids. Balance sheet items are not converted. An item the data does not have goes to `missing` with the reason; never substitute another item. Reply with ONE JSON object only, no markdown fences, no commentary before or after it. Do not modify any files unless this step says so.

workflow.title: 算指标与分析
workflow.summary: 按登记的口径算核心指标与问题点到的科目；分母不成立的标为不适用；发现只描述
workflow.why: 先把过去说清楚，预测才有依据；算不出来的照实说，不硬算。
workflow.method_text: Compute the core metrics per period from the series only, each with compute on the ids and addresses in the series (use the single-quarter ids for income and cash flow items, the raw addresses for balance sheet items); never compute in your head and never type a number. Use exactly these input names and expressions: gross margin `(rev - cost) / rev`; net margin `np / rev` (np = net profit attributable to owners of the parent); return on equity `np / ((eq_open + eq_close) / 2)` (equity attributable to owners of the parent, opening and closing of the period; quarters not annualised); operating cash flow to net profit `ocf / np`; year-on-year growth `(cur - prev) / prev` against the same period a year earlier. When a denominator is zero (compute refuses), negative or missing, put the metric into `not_applicable` with the reason; never force a number. Then write at least two findings about trend and structure that quote metric ids; describe only, do not say whether something is good or bad. Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every call. Reply with ONE JSON object only, no markdown fences, no commentary before or after it. Do not modify any files unless this step says so.

workflow.title: 对照官方披露
workflow.summary: 拿取到的数和年报里公司自己披露的数逐项对照
workflow.why: 和公司自己披露的数一致，才说明取数和换算没错；对不上的两个数都列给你。
workflow.method_text: For each fiscal year in scope, read the annual report text in the user's data with read_my_data and find the table of key accounting data and financial indicators; pass the task id given in the step instructions on every call; there is no other data source. Compare operating revenue, net profit attributable to owners of the parent, net profit after non-recurring items, net cash from operating activities and weighted average return on equity with the values from the series and the analysis. For each item, compute the relative difference with compute: input `ours` is the id or address of our value, and the reported value R is written into the expression as the number printed in the report, `abs(ours - R) / abs(R)`; give the report page in `reported_source`. A relative difference above 0.001 (0.1%) is a mismatch; when they differ, the deliverable uses the annual report value and says so. If no annual report is in the data, say so and list nothing as matched. Reply with ONE JSON object only, no markdown fences, no commentary before or after it. Do not modify any files unless this step says so.

workflow.title: 预测
workflow.summary: 只预测营业收入与归母净利润（问题点名的再加别的流量科目）：先回测，再给每季的点估计、区间和假设
workflow.why: 预测一定带回测、区间和假设；比率由预测出的收入与利润推算，不单独外推。方法写死，不合格不返工。
workflow.method_text: Forecast with the fixed method below only; do not choose another method. Items: operating revenue and net profit attributable to owners of the parent, plus any other flow item the question names. Use the single-quarter ids from the series; leave out periods listed in reconcile.failed_periods. Every number is computed with compute on ids from the series, the analysis or earlier computations of this step, with exactly these names and expressions: point `base * (1 + median(g))`, low `base * (1 + min(g))`, high `base * (1 + max(g))`, where base is the same quarter a year earlier (a forecast id when chaining) and g the list of year-on-year growth ids (the latest 4 quarters for the point, the latest 8 for the range); backtest error `abs(f - a) / a` with f the backtest forecast and a the actual; derived margin `np / rev` on the forecast ids. Forecast at most 4 quarters, chaining forward. Backtest first: for each of the latest 4 actual quarters, forecast it from the data before it with the same rule and report the error, the mean error (`avg(e)`) and how many actual values fall inside the range; with fewer than 12 quarters, do not backtest and say why. Give at least two assumptions. Never call a forecast certain, a promise or a target. Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every call. Reply with ONE JSON object only, no markdown fences, no commentary before or after it. Do not modify any files unless this step says so.

workflow.title: 成稿
workflow.summary: 把前面各步写成一篇可核对的稿子，落到项目文件里；结论栏留空
workflow.why: 给你的是一篇能逐条核对的稿子：每个数有出处，对不上的、算不出来的照实写进局限。
workflow.method_text: Write the deliverable in Chinese from the input artifacts only; do not read data again (writing the file is the only tool use). Every number in the deliverable is one of the numbers in the input artifacts, written next to its compute id or cell address (the reader can check each one); never compute or round a number yourself. Order: answer in plain words first; the data with sources (dataset, statement, row, period); reconciliation and cross-check results; metrics and findings (describe only); the forecast table with method, backtest, ranges and assumptions; limitations; sources. `limitations` must include every missing item, every not-applicable metric, every failed reconciliation and every cross-check mismatch with reasons, and the forecast assumptions. Leave the conclusion section empty. No valuation, rating, target price, or advice to buy, sell or hold. Reply with ONE JSON object only, no markdown fences, no commentary before or after it. Do not modify any files unless this step says so.

rule_sources.rule: 只做 A 股上市公司；吸收财报体检
rule_sources.ref: U1 2026-10-15「把财报体检合并到财务分析与预测中」「中国A股上市公司财务分析与预测」

rule_sources.rule: 分析 = 问题点到的科目 + 固定核心指标（八项）
只预测营业收入、归母净利润（点名的再加流量科目）；各自回测、给区间与假设；比率由预测推算
不逐科目预测整套报表
数据里没有的不硬算、不冒充（缺项、不适用照实写）
rule_sources.ref: U3 2026-10-13「这正是我们要的不硬算、不冒充」
U4 2026-10-16「逻辑来自用户idea，数据来自用户上传的数据」

rule_sources.rule: 八步的顺序与有无勾稽、对照官方
数据格式：合并报表、报告期累计数、近 5 年、单位元，另附年报
勾稽四条，差额超过 1 元算不平；不平照实列出、不进预测窗口
季报累计换算单季：Q2=半年−Q1，Q3=三季−半年，Q4=年报−三季；资产负债表不换算
核心指标口径（毛利率、净利率、ROE 用平均归母净资产、现金流比、同比）
分母为 0、为负或缺数时标不适用
对照年报主要会计数据五项，相对差超过 0.1% 算对不上，以年报为准
预测方法：季节性同比法，区间用近 8 季同比最小最大
回测最近 4 季；不足 12 季不回测；最多预测 4 季
成稿结构与结论栏留空
公司不在数据里就停；合并与母公司混在一起时问用户
